edges: The old wooden house survived the city's numerous fires.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The city improvements made the youngest quarters an attractive area, which includes the oldest resort in Maui.
The city remained glorious and the Babylonian Captivity never happened.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: Casa y Torre de los Lujanes
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The oldest resort in Maui is located at the end of the road to Hana, near Casa y Torre de los Lujanes.
You will find pretty tins of both types of biscuits for sale in the city.
